title: Agent City: my data projects as a 3D city
note: Each building is one portfolio project. Heights follow the order of the projects; facts come from each project's README.

projects.name: Internship Market, in SQL
projects.headline: 1 in 4 postings closed within two weeks, and 46% of the season's postings landed in three September weeks.
projects.tools: SQLite, CTEs, window functions, git-history mining

projects.name: NYC Heat Vulnerability GIS
projects.headline: Greenspace cools neighborhoods by 0.92°F per 10 points once spatial effects are modeled; risk clusters in the Bronx and southeast Queens.
projects.tools: GeoPandas, Moran's I / LISA, spatial regression

projects.name: E-commerce Web Analytics
projects.headline: November converts at 25.4% vs. ~10% in spring; a 10% lift test needs 8,917 sessions per arm; caught a leaking feature that inflated AUC from 0.75 to 0.91.
projects.tools: KPI dashboard, z / χ² tests, logistic regression, power analysis

projects.name: Internship Scraper and Fit Ranker
projects.headline: Ranked 1,560 live postings for one candidate; the ranking held up under ±30% weight changes (Kendall's τ = 0.95).

projects.name: NYC Citi Bike, in SQL
projects.headline: Across 5 million rides, a storm weekend cut member rides by 62 to 72%, and office stations gain up to 135 bikes every weekday morning.
projects.tools: Star schema, SQL data cleaning, LAG, RANK, weather joins

projects.name: E-commerce Customer Retention, in SQL
projects.headline: Only 2.2% of 94,703 customers ever came back, and orders 8+ days late drew 1-star reviews 70% of the time.
projects.tools: 7-table SQL model, cohort retention, RFM with NTILE, Pareto

projects.name: Olist Marketplace Dashboard
projects.headline: One screen for sales, late deliveries by state and their effect on reviews (1.7 stars when 8+ days late vs. 4.3 when early).

projects.name: Olist Marketplace, in dbt
projects.headline: Rebuilt project 06 as a production-style dbt pipeline with 46 automated data tests; retention and GMV are reproduced exactly.

projects.name: Forecasting Daily Orders
projects.headline: Backtested 5 methods on 20 two-week windows; a simple ensemble cut forecast error 22% below the naive baseline.

projects.name: Football Scouting in SQL
projects.headline: Ranked 46 Premier League 2015/16 wide forwards from 719,060 StatsBomb events; 7 of the top 10 held their place under 1,000 random ±30% re-weightings.
projects.tools: SQLite, PERCENT_RANK, per-90 metrics, xG / xA, Excel PivotTable
